piezas.titulo: Reading words: Family and close people
texto: Reading and spelling of family terms: «พ่อ» and «แม่» both begin with low-class consonants (พ and ม) with the tone mark ่ (mái eek), which with low-class consonants gives a falling tone (เสียงโท). «พี่», in turn, combines the low-class consonant พ with the upper long vowel ี and the sign ่ (falling tone), while «น้อง» carries the sign ้ (mái thoo) on the low-class consonant น, producing a high tone (เสียงตรี). Mastering these tones guarantees clear and respectful pronunciation.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «คำว่า พี่ และ น้อง มักใช้เรียกคนทั่วไปในสังคมเพื่อแสดงความสนิทสนม» express?

opciones.texto: The words «phîi» and «nɔ́ɔng» are often used with strangers to show closeness.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «คำว่า พี่ และ น้อง มักใช้เรียกคนทั่วไปในสังคมเพื่อแสดงความสนิทสนม» from the text.

opciones.texto: Caring for the family is a central value passed down over time.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Living together across several generations nurtures affection and unity in the home.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «น้อง» (younger brother/sister), what tone results from combining the low-class consonant น with the sign ้ (mái thoo)?

opciones.texto: High tone (เสียงตรี)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a low-class consonant with the mark ้ is always pronounced with a high tone.
Incorrect: the falling tone on low-class consonants is obtained with the sign ่.
Incorrect: low-class consonants never produce a low tone with the sign ้.
